description.en: Survev.io is an open-source 2D battle royale game inspired by surviv.io.

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Show only the game name; hide status, match information, and timestamps.

settings.title: Show Browsing Status
settings.description: Show menus, team lobby, and matchmaking.

settings.title: Show Game State
settings.description: Show gameplay, spectating, and match results.

settings.title: Show Match Information
settings.description: Show detected mode, players alive, and your kills during gameplay.

settings.title: Show Timestamp
settings.description: Show elapsed time since the Activity detected the match or opened the site.

settings.title: Show Party Size
settings.description: Show occupied slots and capacity in the team lobby without player names or invite codes.

settings.title: Show Status Icon
settings.description: Show a small icon while browsing, finding a match, or spectating.

settings.title: Hide While Spectating
settings.description: Clear the Activity while spectating a match.

settings.title: Hide Match Results
settings.description: Clear the Activity while viewing match results.
